_about: Magic (M6, crates/core/src/orbs.rs): the kinds of orb and the patterns cast in the MVP (M7: the practice begins with practice_one, a single orb, then practice_few, three, before the practice pattern itself, trainer.rs), after Long Time Comin's data/patterns.json. A kind is a shape (sphere, tetra, octa, cube, star, torus; no two kinds share one, CW-10), a colour (0-255) for its body and its halo, a radius in cm, the health a hit takes, whether an imbued blade can turn it, and what turning or landing it does: none; knock (turning it jars the sword arm: both arms weakened for knock_ticks); shove (turning it pushes the player back at shove_cms); stun (turned back, it weakens both of what it hits's arms in full). A pattern is a list of volleys, each fired from before the caster's chest at the player's chest. Forms: fan (count orbs spread_deg wide in all, flat across the line to the player), ring (count orbs on a circle radius_cm round the line, in the plane facing the player, hanging hold ticks before they fly: launch aim, each at the chest then, or along the line), wave (a row of count orbs spacing_cm apart across the line, a hole gap orbs wide that moves left, middle, right as the volley repeats). Every volley: kind, speed_cms (cm a second), delay (ticks after the cast before the first repeat), repeat (how many), every (ticks between repeats), spin_deg (a ring turns this far each repeat: a spiral), sweep_deg (a fan turns from one side to the other over its repeats), curl_degs (each orb turns this many degrees a second as it flies; alternate turns every other one the other way). turned is the colour every turned orb takes, body and halo.
